name: BRLA Digital
oneLiner: BRLA is Avenia's centralized Brazilian real stablecoin, mint/redeemed 1:1 for BRL and backed by Brazilian government bonds and BRL cash in regulated custody.
collateral: Brazilian government bonds (titulos publicos) and BRL cash held in regulated custody in Brazil; reserves audited monthly by a third-party firm with attestations published on a transparency page
pegMechanism: Fiat-backed 1:1 peg to the Brazilian Real; mint/redeem 1:1 for BRL through Avenia (formerly BRLA Digital) platform after KYC; native multichain deployment without wrapping or bridge dependencies

proofOfReserves.provider: External audit firm disclosed through BRLA transparency materials

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

mintAuthority.summary: BRLA is issued by Avenia (formerly BRLA Digital); mint() on each chain requires the issuer-held operator role; on Polygon two EOAs currently hold the role, on Gnosis four addresses (3 EOAs + 1 proxy contract) hold the role — all confirmed via on-chain hasRole reads.

controls.label: Avenia operator wallet — Polygon (primary)
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 88321577, hasRole(0xf48dee1a…,0x36cd3733…) returned true on proxy 0xe6a537…; eth_getCode returned no bytecode (EOA). Role hash 0xf48dee1a72497b9e734e498e1b3086c0d2dbcca13f16f15848f974469f906bbf is the sole mint-capable role constant in the deployed bytecode (confirmed via PUSH32 bytecode scan). mint() is onlyRole and no role-enumeration is exposed (non-enumerable AccessControlUpgradeable, UUPS proxy, no proxy admin).

controls.label: Avenia operator wallet — Polygon (secondary)
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 88321577, hasRole(0xf48dee1a…,0x55127198…) returned true; eth_getCode = no bytecode (EOA). No RoleRevoked events for this address.

controls.label: Avenia operator wallets — Gnosis (EOAs)
controls.evidence: At Gnosis block 46643103, three EOAs hold the operator role (0x97667070…) on 0xfecb3f7c…: 0x19df6878…, 0xbb6878b9…, 0xca0402fb… — all confirmed hasRole=true; code=0 for each. A fourth holder (0xa5e1a817…) is an ERC1967Proxy (340 bytes) representing the Avenia minting backend. Celo deployment at the same address uses the same pattern.

review.evidence: Polygon block 88321577: two EOA operator role holders confirmed via hasRole; role hash 0xf48dee1a… is the only mint-capable constant in bytecode (BRLAV1_1 / UUPS, non-enumerable AccessControl). Gnosis block 46643103: three EOA + one ERC1967Proxy operator role holders confirmed. Celo uses the same contract address. Moonbeam totalSupply=0 (inactive). BRLA contract source (BRLAV1_1) verifies mint() gated by the operator role. No proxy admin on any deployment; upgrader role is separate.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: BRLA is reviewed as an issuer-native multichain token: supply is issued or redeemed by the issuer/operator on supported chains rather than through a separately identified third-party bridge token. Missing evidence for a public bridge lockbox keeps confidence below verified.
